name: Clapham Common Playground
description: Lambeth Council's Windmill Drive playground on Clapham Common was redesigned as a bigger, inclusive play area, with wooden wildlife sculptures and a bug hotel, and won a PiPA Gold Award. A water play area with jets, designed for children with physical, developmental and sensory disabilities as well, opened on the common in July 2023.
